# Miscellaneous ingredient substitution groups
# status: DRAFT. Written from general brewing knowledge. Not copied from, and not verified against, any reference site;
# review before relying on a line and flip the last column to `reviewed`.
#
# line format: id | members (separated by ;) | tier | what changes | review
# tier: close = near drop-in | fair = same role, noticeable difference | distant = last resort | never = do NOT swap
# Dosage differs by product: always read the pack and ask the user when the dose is not obvious.
# Search with: grep -i "<name>" knowledge/misc.md
#
X-KETTLE-FINING | Irish moss; Whirlfloc; Whirlfloc tablet; Protafloc; Protafloc tablets; Kettle fining; Kettle finings; Koppers Clear | close | all are boil clarifiers; dose by product (a tablet is not a teaspoon of moss), follow the pack | draft
X-YEAST-NUTRIENT | Yeast nutrient; Yeast nutrients; Fermaid; Fermaid K; Fermaid O; Rauga barība; Rauga barības vielas; Barības viela vīna rauga; Mangrove Jack's Yeast Nutrient; Browin Hefenährsalze; Browin Kombi Vita; Nutrisal; Nutriferm | fair | all supply nitrogen and minerals; complete products (with vitamins and organic nitrogen) are stronger than DAP-type nitrogen salts | draft
X-DAP | Diammonium phosphate; DAP; Diammonija fosfāts; Yeast nutrient | distant | pure nitrogen and phosphate with no vitamins or organic nitrogen; usable for wine and mead, a poor beer substitute | draft
X-ACID-LACTIC | Lactic acid; Lactic acid 80%; Pienskābe; Acidulated malt; Sauermalz | fair | lactic acid is clean and soft; acidulated malt does the same job via the mash | draft
X-ACID-PHOS | Phosphoric acid; Fosforskābe; Lactic acid; Lactic acid 80% | fair | phosphoric is flavour-neutral, lactic adds a gentle tang; strength differs (check %), adjust with a pH tool | draft
X-ACID-WINE | Tartaric acid; Vīnskābe; Citric acid; Malic acid; Acid blend | fair | winemaking acids with different taste: tartaric is sharp and stable, citric is fruity and can ferment away, malic is apple-like | draft
X-SALT-CALCIUM | Gypsum; Calcium sulfate; Kalcija sulfāts; Ģipsis; Calcium chloride; Kalcija hlorīds; Kalcija hlorīda pārslas | never | gypsum adds sulfate (crisp, bitter-accentuating), calcium chloride adds chloride (soft, full); they set opposite profiles; never swap without a water recalculation | draft
X-SALT-OTHER | Potassium chloride; Kālija hlorīds; Sodium chloride; Table salt; Epsom salt | never | potassium chloride is a salt substitute, not a brewing water salt; never use in place of calcium or magnesium salts | draft
X-SALT-MG | Epsom salt; Magnesium sulfate; Magnija sulfāts; Epsoma sāļi | never | magnesium source; do not use in place of calcium salts | draft
X-CHALK | Chalk; Calcium carbonate; Kalcija karbonāts; Krīts; Baking soda; Sodium bicarbonate | never | raises alkalinity; calcium carbonate dissolves poorly and baking soda adds sodium; not interchangeable with calcium salts | draft
X-WOOD | Oak chips; Oak; Ozola skaidas; Ozola šķeldas; Ozols; Ķirsis; Ābele; Koksnes šķeldas; American oak; French oak; AddWood; Oak cubes; Medium toast oak; Cherry wood; Apple wood | fair | American oak is vanilla and coconut, French oak is spicy and tight; toast level matters; fruit woods are milder | draft
X-FRUIT-PEEL | Bitter orange peel; Sweet orange peel; Orange peel; Apelsīnu miziņas; Rūgtā apelsīna miziņas; Lemon peel; Citronu miziņas | fair | bitter orange peel is more bitter and floral than sweet; both can serve as a witbier spice | draft
X-SPICE-CORIANDER | Coriander; Coriander seed; Koriandrs; Koriandra sēklas | distant | witbier spicing; there is no substitute that behaves the same | draft
X-JUNIPER | Juniper berries; Kadiķogas; Juniper | distant | piney and resinous; closest are small amounts of pine-like hops or gin botanicals, not an exact match | draft
X-FINING-WINE | Bentonite; Bentonīts; Isinglass; Gelatin; Gelatine; Kieselsol; Biersol; Chitosan | fair | clearing agents with different targets: bentonite removes proteins, gelatin and isinglass drop yeast and haze, check the target and compatibility | draft
X-CARBON | Activated carbon; Aktivētā ogle; Kokosa ogle; Minerālā ogle; Aktivētā kokosa ogle; Aktivētā minerālā ogle; Charcoal; Koka ogle | distant | adsorbs colour and off-flavours; strengths differ by product; mostly for distilling and wine | draft
X-PRESERVATIVE | Campden; Campden tablets; Sodium metabisulfite; Potassium metabisulfite; Metabisulfīts; Nātrija metabisulfīts; Kālija metabisulfīts; K-meta; Na-meta | fair | sulfite sources; potassium is preferred in wine, sodium is fine for sanitising and fining out chlorine; dose by sulfite content | draft
X-ANTIOXIDANT | Ascorbic acid; Askorbinskābe; Vitamin C; Campden; Metabisulfite | distant | both protect against oxidation, but sulfite also kills microbes and ascorbic acid is best used together with sulfite, not instead of it | draft
X-HOPEXTRACT | Isomerized hop extract; Iso-alpha acid extract; Apiņu ekstrakts izomerizēts; Apiņu ekstrakts; Hop extract | distant | adds bitterness only, no aroma; dose by its iso-alpha acid percentage and read the pack; real hops are the normal route | draft
X-ENZYME | Glucoamylase; Glikoamilāze; Alpha-amylase; Amylase; Pectic enzyme; Pectinase; Glucanase; Murphy and Son Glucanase | never | each enzyme has a different job (starch, dextrins, pectin haze, beta-glucan); not interchangeable | draft
X-PRESERVATIVE-SORBATE | Potassium sorbate; Kālija sorbāts; Sodium benzoate; Nātrija benzoāts | never | stabilisers with different mechanisms and legal limits; do not swap without rechecking the dose and purpose | draft
X-PRIMING | Dextrose; Glucose; Corn sugar; Sugar; Cukurs; Priming sugar; Honey; Medus | fair | dextrose and table sugar prime the same; honey is only about 80% sugar and carries flavour, scale up by about 1.25 | draft
